content: रेखा [लिख्-अच् लस्य रः] .²1 A line, streak; मदरेखा, दानरेखा, रागरेखा <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The measure of a line, small portion, as much as a line; न रेखामात्रमपि व्यतीयुः <ls>R. 1. 17</ls>. .²3 A row, range, line, series; मुदाश्रु मोक्ष्यसे क्षिप्रं मेघरेखेव वार्षिकी <ls>Rām. 2. 44. 27</ls>. .²4 Delineation, sketch, drawing; लावण्यरेखया किंचिदन्वितम् <ls>Ś. 6. 13</ls>. .²5 The first or prime meridian of the Indian astronomers drawn from Laṅkā to Meru and passing through Ujjayinī. .²6 Fulness, satisfaction. .²7 Deceit, fraud. .²8 A straight position of all limbs in dancing.
